# PrismJS 1.30.0

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/prismjs/-/prismjs-1.30.0.tgz

MIT licensed; license included. Core and all language components are bundled locally in dependency order using upstream dependencies.js. Manual mode prevents DOM rewriting. ArkTS extends TypeScript; Vue extends markup with JavaScript interpolation. Regenerate with `node scripts/sync-prism.cjs <unpacked-package-path>`.
